title: Annotation API v2 text embedding request

model.description: Embedding model. `gte` is a text-only model; `openclip` and `siglip2` embed text in the same space as their image embeddings.

normalize.description: Return the L2-normalised embedding (true) or the raw model output (false). With `dimensions`, normalisation applies to the cut vector.

dimensions.description: Number of leading dimensions to keep (Matryoshka cut). Only with `model` `gte`.

examples.data: a photo of a steam locomotive
